events.title: The Shield-Menders
events.description: At a shield repair queue, a huge patched shield props up the town gate.

choices.text: Stand watch by the giant shield (+2 scraps)
Trade a spare shield rivet (spend 1 scrap; gain 17 gold)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: Scarlet Thread Cart
events.description: The seamstress finds a wagon knotted with red-thread pennants and giant needles.

choices.text: Sew the red pennant (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Buy a red-thread bundle (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: The Clockwork Wagon
events.description: A clockwork trader's wagon ticks under a load of crooked buttons and gears.

choices.text: Gather the fallen gears (+1 scrap)
Repair the wagon ratchet (spend 2 scraps; gain 28 gold)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: Moth Vigil
events.description: A warm patchwork lantern gathers moths beside a candlelit cloth shrine.

choices.text: Guide the moths by lantern light (+2 scraps)
Buy lantern wax (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: The Needle Fair
events.description: A caped duelist holds a friendly fencing fair with a long thin needle rapier.

choices.text: Win the friendly fencing purse (+20 gold)
Buy two red ribbon bundles (spend 10 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: The Crow's Threshing
events.description: A black crow perches on a burlap-headed straw doll beside an overgrown granary.

choices.text: Gather loose straw ties (+2 scraps)
Trade a bundle of crow feathers (spend 1 scrap; gain 19 gold)
Leave the roost untouched

events.title: The Knitted Ford
events.description: A narrow crossing is webbed with wool bolas and two bent knitting-needle posts.

choices.text: Retrieve a spool tangled in the ford (+1 scrap)
Buy fresh coloured wool (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Cross without disturbing the knitting

events.title: The Giant Button Press
events.description: A rattling bronze press stamps brass buttons as a towering button-bodied golem waits.

choices.text: Feed the press two scrap bundles (spend 2 scraps; gain 31 gold)
Collect fallen button shanks (+1 scrap)
Leave the button press

events.title: The Evening Beacon
events.description: Moths ring a dim lantern pole while travellers queue to relight their stitched lamps.

choices.text: Trim the beacon wick (spend 1 scrap; gain 16 gold)
Buy two wax spools (spend 10 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the lantern burn

events.title: The Scarlet Fencing Fair
events.description: A feather-hatted puppet duelist invites the party to a needle-rapier bout.

choices.text: Win the fencing purse (+22 gold)
Buy fresh fencing ribbons (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Bow and leave the fair

events.title: The Moonshield Watch
events.description: A button-eyed sentry stands beneath a bone-cream moon with a shield patched from midnight-blue coats.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold to polish the moonshield (+2 scraps)
Trade a spare shield stitch (spend 1 scrap; gain 21 gold)
Lower the shield and move on

events.title: The Scarlet Midnight Loom
events.description: A wide-eyed doll weaver tends a giant red needle, its loose threads glowing beside a plum velvet loom.

choices.text: Retie the snapped needle thread (+2 scraps)
Sell two spare thread bundles (spend 2 scraps; gain 24 gold)
Leave the loom humming

events.title: The Midnight Gearhouse
events.description: A hunched scrap-pack automaton sorts blunderbuss springs beneath lantern-lit copper shutters.

choices.text: Collect fallen spring teeth (+1 scrap)
Tune the scrap gears (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)
Leave the clockwork ticking

events.title: The Blackcrow Post
events.description: A straw-stuffed watchman and its crow perch at a dusk-lit letterpost wrapped in worn denim.

choices.text: Follow the crow to a lost purse (+13 gold)
Buy twine to bind the loose straw (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the crow keep watch

events.title: The Knitted Bolas Bridge
events.description: Knitting-needle arches stretch across a misty ford, hung with teal yarn bolas and mossy wool.

choices.text: Reel in the drifting bolas (+2 scraps)
Trade a knitting-needle spool (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Cross without tangling the bridge

events.title: The Button-Bell Foundry
events.description: A huge round button golem braces a brass mould beneath dark-ink bells and candlelight.

choices.text: Steady the giant button mould (+17 gold)
Buy brass-thread spools (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the foundry ringing

events.title: The Buckle Checkpoint
events.description: A shield-wide patchwork watchtower guards the threadbare road while brass buckles rattle in the wind.

choices.text: Brace the caravan for a 16-gold watchman's wage
Trade two spare buckle scraps for 27 gold
Lower the shield and continue

events.title: The Crimson Mending Queue
events.description: A long row of button-eyed dolls waits beneath a giant red needle for a fresh hem.

choices.text: Sew the queue's frayed hems for two scraps
Spend 16 gold on three moonlit thread scraps
Fold the needle away and leave

events.title: The Clockwork Sideshow
events.description: A hunched goggle-maker's blunderbuss gears turn a little mechanical puppet stage.

choices.text: Repair the clockwork cog for a 20-gold fee
Pay 12 gold for two spring-cap scraps
Let the puppet stage go quiet

events.title: The Crow-Lantern Post
events.description: A black crow guards a lantern-lit granary where loose straw spills from stitched sacks.

choices.text: Gather one bundle of loose straw scraps
Trade two straw scraps for 23 gold
Leave the crow on its post

events.title: The Wool Signal Station
events.description: Knitting-needle signal masts span a misty ridge, hung with moss-green yarn bolas.

choices.text: Reel in two scraps of loose signal wool
Trade two bolas-knot scraps for 24 gold
Cross beneath the silent wool signals

events.title: The Rivet Bridge
events.description: A giant button-bodied porter holds a brass-riveted bridge steady in the dusk.

choices.text: Hold the bridge for an 18-gold porter's wage
Spend 17 gold on three brass-thread scraps
Let the bridge settle and go

events.title: The Mothglass Chapel
events.description: A round saffron-robed doll tends an amber lantern under stained button-glass; moths circle a cracked wick.

choices.text: Relight the saffron wick (spend 1 scrap; earn 22 gold)
Gather the fallen lantern wax (+1 scrap)
Leave the chapel's moths undisturbed

events.title: The Velvet Rapier Stage
events.description: A caped puppet challenges the Duelist to match his crimson ribbon against a blunted needle rapier.

choices.text: Win the velvet purse in a ribbon duel (+14 gold)
Buy fencing silk (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the puppet to bow alone

events.title: The Brass-Moth Clinic
events.description: A bent-wing clockwork moth ticks on a gear-backed stool beneath a warm mustard lamp.

choices.text: Repair the moth's wing (spend 2 scraps; earn 27 gold)
Gather discarded clock springs (+1 scrap)
Leave the brass moth resting

events.title: The Pumpkin-Seam Census
events.description: A plump burlap registrar counts pumpkin buttons while the Scarecrow's crow perches on a stitched ledger.

choices.text: Register the harvest (spend 1 scrap; earn 18 gold)
Gather loose hay offcuts (+2 scraps)
Leave the census table

events.title: The Tangled Willow
events.description: Knitting-needle branches cradle teal yarn above a lantern-lit river; the Ranger's bolas can reel it down.

choices.text: Retrieve the fallen wool cache (+10 gold)
Buy moss-green bolas cord (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the willow undisturbed

events.title: The Brass Keyhole
events.description: A huge moss-green door opens only when giant button fists press its rusted rivets.

choices.text: Push the rivet door (spend 2 scraps; earn 29 gold)
Gather loose button shanks (+1 scrap)
Leave the door closed

events.title: The Copper-Chain Ferry
events.description: A stout button-eyed ferryman hangs from a copper chain while the Warden's enormous patched shield braces his tilting boat.

choices.text: Brace the ferry chain with the great shield (gain 20 gold)
Buy brass shield buckles (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the ferry drift past

events.title: The Needle-Eye Oracle
events.description: A round velvet oracle peers through a huge sewing-needle eye as scarlet threads bind a midnight-plum fortune quilt.

choices.text: Unpick the oracle's snare (spend 1 scrap; earn 24 gold)
Buy fortune silk (spend 18 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the red threads tied

events.title: The Spring Marionette
events.description: A stubby clockwork marionette lies beneath a brass spring chandelier, its bright button heart stalled inside a sewn chest.

choices.text: Use two scrap bundles to rewind its heart (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Gather discarded spring gears (gain 2 scraps)
Let the marionette sleep

events.title: The Mothlight Ferry
events.description: A candlelit ferry of round stitched moth dolls follows the Lantern Monk's glowing pole across dark teal water.

choices.text: Guide the moth passengers ashore (gain 19 gold)
Buy spare mothlight wicks (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the moth ferry sail away

events.title: The Split-Cape Tribunal
events.description: A crimson velvet judge in a button eyepatch holds court beneath torn capes, with a thin needle rapier laid across the dais.

choices.text: Sew the judge's split cape (spend 1 scrap; earn 23 gold)
Buy gilt rapier-thread guards (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Bow without entering the tribunal

events.title: The Raven-Sewn Orchard
events.description: Plump pumpkin ragdolls sit among button apples while the Scarecrow's black crow watches over a row of stitched straw baskets.

choices.text: Guard the stuffed harvest from ravens (gain 2 scraps)
Trade two bundles of pitchfork twine (spend 2 scraps; gain 29 gold)
Leave the orchard to its crows

events.title: The Pincushion Gate
events.description: A dented-pot-helmet Warden braces a huge slate patch shield against a moonlit gate bristling with brass sewing pins.

choices.text: Hold the gate for the night watch (gain 22 gold)
Buy quilted shield lacing (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Walk away from the gate

events.title: The Crimson Bell Cord
events.description: An oversized sewing needle has pinned a frayed scarlet thread-rope beneath a plum velvet bell tower.

choices.text: Rethread the bell (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)
Collect loose red thread (gain 2 scraps)
Let the bell sleep

events.title: The Mothveil Passage
events.description: A stout robed lantern keeper and round stitched moths illuminate a dark quilted passage in saffron and teal.

choices.text: Guide lost travellers by lantern (gain 18 gold)
Pay 16 gold for three scraps of spare wick thread
Pass the lantern arch

events.title: The Cape Windmill
events.description: A tattered oxblood cape catches in the sails of a storybook windmill; a slender needle rapier glints beneath the brass hub.

choices.text: Free the trapped sails using 1 scrap and earn 24 gold
Gather the fallen cape ribbons (gain 2 scraps)
Leave the mill to the wind

events.title: The Yarn-Bolas Mooring
events.description: Two giant knitting needles mark a river mooring tangled with moss-green wool bolas and teal bowstring.

choices.text: Untangle two useful thread bundles (gain 2 scraps)
Spend 1 scrap and earn 20 gold trading knots
Cross without touching the wool

events.title: The Buttonlift
events.description: A towering button-bodied doll stands beneath a dangling brass-button lift over a stitched ravine.

choices.text: Raise the stranded lift with giant button fists (gain 23 gold)
Buy brass button fittings (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the lift settle

events.title: The Cinder Shield Parade
events.description: A squat guard with a dented pot helmet braces a giant slate patch shield beneath oxblood procession flags and glowing lantern coals.

choices.text: Brace the burning procession (spend 2 scraps; gain 26 gold)
Buy shield rivets (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the lantern procession pass

events.title: The Ribbon-Heart Gallery
events.description: A needle the size of a staff threads scarlet ribbons between plush velvet hearts beneath a bone-cream gallery roof.

choices.text: Mend the torn velvet hearts (spend 2 scraps; gain 31 gold)
Buy silver glimmer needles (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the hearts hanging

events.title: The Thunder-Spool Dock
events.description: A hunchbacked gearsmith with a scrap blunderbuss winds copper turbines beside a storm-lit mountain of wooden spools.

choices.text: Rewind the dock engines (spend 3 scraps; gain 33 gold)
Buy copper clock springs (spend 11 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the turbines unwound

events.title: The Moon-Moth Procession
events.description: A round saffron-robed lantern keeper guides button-eyed moth dolls across a midnight-teal bridge of embroidered stars.

choices.text: Guide the moth pilgrims (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Buy amber lantern wicks (spend 18 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Watch the lanterns float away

events.title: The Strawmoon Watch
events.description: A pumpkin-orange sack head and pitchfork stand beside a black crow on a velvet roof while straw bells ring across the moonlit fields.

choices.text: Guard the midnight crow bell (spend 2 scraps; gain 22 gold)
Buy fresh harvest twine (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the straw bells ringing

events.title: The Bronze-Rivet Choir
events.description: A huge button-bodied doll steadies a falling brass-button organ while tiny velvet singers hold its fraying thread pipes.

choices.text: Raise the giant button organ (spend 3 scraps; gain 37 gold)
Buy brass rivet thread (spend 20 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the choir to its song

events.title: The Fog-Bell Loom
events.description: A squat button-eyed bell keeper points to a brass bell snagged in moss-green wool; the Yarn Ranger's knitting-needle bow and teal bolas can reel down its rope.

choices.text: Reel down the fog bell (spend 2 scraps; gain 25 gold)
Gather loose teal wool knots (gain 2 scraps)
Leave the bell hidden in the mist

events.title: The Velvet Mirror Duel
events.description: A plump velvet mirror puppet raises a needle rapier at the Rag Duelist; candlelight catches his tattered crimson cape and the puppet's gold-button eyepatch.

choices.text: Parry the mirror puppet's needle (gain 21 gold)
Buy fresh velvet cape lace (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Bow to the puppet and leave

events.title: The Crow-Letter Post
events.description: A black crow carries red wax letters to a squat burlap postmaster; the Scarecrow's pitchfork holds the stitched mailbag above a pumpkin-lit desk.

choices.text: Deliver the crow's sealed letters (spend 1 scrap; gain 24 gold)
Collect discarded straw seals (gain 1 scrap)
Leave the letters unopened

events.title: The Midnight Button Clock
events.description: A great round midnight-teal clock has stopped between two huge brass buttons; the Button Golem's stacked button fists fit its missing hand-shaped crank.

choices.text: Turn the button clock's heavy crank (gain 26 gold)
Buy spare clock spring thread (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let midnight wait another hour

events.title: The Sable Grain Clock
events.description: A stuffed black crow rocks on a towering burlap grain-clock while a huge pitchfork serves as its rusted hand; pale straw falls through stitched hourglass panes.

choices.text: Guide the crow to two loose bundles of clock straw (+2 scraps)
Trade one scrap of worn bell strap for 21 gold
Let the crooked grain-clock mark another hour

events.title: The Needlebow Orrery
events.description: Two giant knitting-needle arms turn a brass moon-model above a velvet field; teal wool bolas have caught a tiny glowing button-star between its rings.

choices.text: Reel in the fallen brass moon for 15 gold
Pay 14 gold for two coils of moon-wool (+2 scraps)
Leave the button-star turning in its rings

events.title: The Staircase Carillon
events.description: Four enormous brass-button chimes hang over a broken stairwell; a round doll keeper asks for the Golem's heavy fists to lift the fallen velvet crank.

choices.text: Use two scrap bundles to lift the crank (earn 28 gold)
Gather one bundle of dropped button shanks (+1 scrap)
Let the silent brass buttons hang over the stairs

events.title: The Oxblood Shield Clock
events.description: An enormous slate-blue shield swings as the pendulum of a crooked roadside clock; the Warden's dented pot helmet props its brass axle while small button-eyed sentries count each candlelit chime.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to steady the swinging shield (gain 28 gold)
Gather two bundles of loose clock rivets (+2 scraps)
Let the huge shield keep its slow time

events.title: The Crimson Shadow Choir
events.description: A row of plump button-eyed glove puppets sings behind a bone-cream curtain; the Seamstress's giant needle lifts scarlet strings from their velvet shoulders beneath a single plum lantern.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap restringing the choir (gain 22 gold)
Pay 17 gold for three reels of choir thread (+3 scraps)
Lower the curtain on the quiet choir

events.title: The Moonbolas Windharp
events.description: Two giant knitting-needle poles carry a web of moss and teal wool; the Yarn Ranger's huge braided bolas have caught three brass crescent chimes above a misty toy-sized road.

choices.text: Gather two fallen moon-wool knots (+2 scraps)
Trade 2 scrap bundles of braided wool for 29 gold
Let the brass moons chime in the wind

events.title: The Ash-Chimney Crow Nest
events.description: A giant patched chimney rises from the floorboards; straw-paper crow nests fill its cracked flue while the Scarecrow's black companion taps a brass button inside the ash.

choices.text: Send the crow after loose flue thread (gain 2 scraps)
Spend 2 scraps binding the damper (earn 28 gold)
Leave the little nests undisturbed

events.title: The Midnight Postbox Spool
events.description: A towering brass letter box leans among woollen hedge walls; the Yarn Ranger's knotted bolas hold its spring flap open as candlelit envelopes tremble inside.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold for three bundles of moonpost braid (+3 scraps)
Spend 1 scrap rewinding the spring flap (earn 23 gold)
Let the sealed letters whisper to themselves

events.title: The Porcelain Button Scale
events.description: A cracked bone-cream dinner plate hangs as the pan of an immense button scale; only the Button Golem's broad stuffed fists can steady its tarnished brass weights.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps steadying the heavy scale (earn 30 gold)
Gather fallen button shanks (+1 scrap)
Let the porcelain pan settle in silence
